name_en: International Community School of Addis Ababa

A leading IB World School in Addis Ababa offering the full IB continuum from Primary Years to Diploma Programme.

The official French school in Addis Ababa, run by the French government. Offers the French Baccalauréat for students from maternelle through terminale.
A well-established international school offering both IB and Ethiopian curricula. Serves both expatriate and Ethiopian families.
Offers British Cambridge curriculum in a green campus environment. Known for its strong extracurricular programs.

Offers Cambridge IGCSE curriculum with a focus on holistic development and modern teaching methods.

One of the oldest Catholic schools in Addis Ababa, founded in 1929. Known for high academic standards and strong discipline.

Branch of the St. Joseph School network in the CMC area, serving the rapidly growing Yeka sub-city population.

Serving the Akaki Kaliti industrial corridor community with affordable and accessible quality private education.
A faith-inspired private school in the historic Arada sub-city, emphasizing both spiritual and academic growth.
An Ethiopian Orthodox Church-affiliated school near the famous Kidus Gabriel Church. Known for its values-based education.
Located near the famous Bole Medhane Alem Church, this school blends Orthodox Ethiopian values with modern education.
A Catholic-affiliated school in the Lideta area serving Ethiopian families with a mission-driven educational approach.
A Protestant church-affiliated school offering affordable quality education in the Nifas Silk-Lafto area.
Ethiopian Orthodox Church school near Kidus Michael Church in the Gulele area. Combines religious and academic education.
A community-focused private school in the Kolfe Keranio area promoting unity and excellence in education.
A growing school in Yeka sub-city with a reputation for excellent ESLCE (national exam) results and strong STEM programs.
A colorful and welcoming elementary private school in Bole known for its creative arts and early childhood programs.

Named after Emperor Menelik II, founder of modern Addis Ababa. One of the oldest and most prestigious public schools in Ethiopia.

description: Named after British General Orde Wingate who helped liberate Ethiopia. A historically significant public school in Addis Ababa.
Located near the historic Entoto hills, this public secondary school serves the Gulele sub-city community.

A government secondary school in Lideta sub-city, one of the major public schools serving the western part of Addis Ababa.
Located near Kotebe Metropolitan University area, this public school serves the Yeka sub-city with secondary education.
A public secondary school near the Shola market area, serving the central Yeka community.
The main public secondary school in Bole sub-city, serving the large population of this rapidly growing district.

description: Public primary school near Addis Ababa University's main campus at Sidist Kilo. Serves the university community area.
Public primary school near the famous Merkato market, one of Africa's largest open-air markets. Serves a high-density commercial area.
A private school in the fast-growing Gerji area of Bole, offering bilingual education with international standards.
Named after the Archangel Michael, this private school serves the CMC residential area of Yeka with quality education.
A modern international school offering American and IB curriculum. Popular among diplomatic community and Ethiopian returnees.

Public secondary school in the Kality area, serving the southern industrial and residential communities.
Public secondary school in the Lafto area of Nifas Silk-Lafto sub-city, serving the southwestern residential communities.
A private school near the national stadium area with a tradition of sports excellence alongside strong academics.
Tsehay (meaning 'sun' in Amharic) School brings bright educational opportunities to the Gulele sub-city community.

A leading British international school in Addis Ababa with over 1,400 students and 290 staff. Offers the National Curriculum for England from Nursery through Year 13 (IGCSE and A-Level), accredited by Pearson Edexcel.

One of Addis Ababa's largest international schools with over 3,000 students across 5 campuses. Operated by ADvTECH, Africa's leading private education group. Offers Cambridge IGCSE and A-Level programs.

Founded in 2006, One Planet International School has grown to serve around 950 students from Kindergarten through Grade 12 in the Summit area. Combines Cambridge curriculum with Ethiopian national standards.

A Christian international school established in 1952, one of the oldest in Ethiopia. Located in the Kolfe area, it follows British curriculum with a Christian ethos, serving the expatriate and missionary community.

A co-educational international school in Yeka Subcity, Woreda 9, offering British and international curriculum from Nursery through Grade 10. Known for quality education with a focus on holistic student development.

A unique school in Kazanchis based on the Finnish National Core Curriculum, ranked among the world's best. Serves 200+ students from Kindergarten to Grade 8 with emphasis on holistic development. Accredited by Cognia and affiliated with Edu Cluster Finland.

An international school founded in 2005, located in Sarbet on Alexander Pushkin Street. Combines Cambridge English with Singapore Math and Science programs. Popular with AU, UNECA, embassy and NGO families.

A private school between CMC and Ayat in Meri Village, Yeka. Offers innovative learning from Kindergarten to Grade 8 with dedicated bus transportation, global school connections, and interactive family programs.

RICE (Reach International Center of Education), established in September 2014, offers Cambridge International curriculum from Year 1 through Year 13. Operates two campuses: Meskel Flower (Years 1–6) and Agona Cinema (Years 7–13).
A private school located in the Jerusalem Memorial Building, Bole Sub City Woreda 2. Offers KG through Grade 12 with a Christian-based educational philosophy.
